description: The investigators encountered a twisted Cthulhu monster head-on, all failed their Sanity checks, and decided to abandon the town and evacuate by train. A huge explosion was heard in the distance, and the fate of the town remains unknown.

conversation.text: The colossal entity crushed everything in its path, metal supports twisted and snapped beneath it, concrete fragments splashed like spray. It broke through the dust with a momentum that could shatter all things, now closing in on player9, the fierce wind it raised slapping against his rigid body.

conversation.speaker: player9

conversation.text: The dagger lay quietly in the pool of blood, emitting a cold gleam, while the thick-backed knife in your hand had snapped clean at the hilt, the shattered steel fragments reflecting your trembling pupils. The countless arms of the approaching monster seemed to mock: Is this the extent of your desperate struggle?

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Catches the passed dagger. Then chooses to close the door.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Clang" The dagger falls at the feet of the three outside the door. In the distance, the colossal entity formed from countless flesh and blood surges towards player9, player9's raised arm as fragile as a twig. Dense, malformed limbs drag him into the churning tide of flesh, human bones emitting a teeth-grating crunching sound under the pressure. The last thing he sees is his own splattering blood, before his consciousness sinks into eternal night. This body that once laughed and ran is now part of the mountain of flesh.

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: "My sister... I leave her to you..."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I know."

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: #Attempt to utter the last words of humanity

conversation.speaker: player4

conversation.speaker: player9

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Picks up the dagger with some resignation, sighs, and turns to leave

conversation.speaker: player4

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Bailan returns to the maintenance workshop, standing before the massive hydraulic press control panel. Dense arrays of buttons and levers gleam coldly in the dim light. His fingers hover slightly trembling, his gaze sweeping over pressure gauges and emergency stop switches, those red and green indicators squatting on the control panel like riddles.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: (No choice but to leave it now?

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Bailan's hands wander frantically over the control panel, buttons pressed disorderly with crackling sounds, indicator lights flickering on and off. Yet the massive hydraulic press remains silently towering, not even a tremor from the hydraulic pipes.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #At this point, can only take the dagger and leave this place first, then prepare to head to the local police station to try and report the situation here

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: From afar comes the thunderous crash of an iron door collapsing, shockwaves traveling along the concrete floor, causing wrenches on the control panel to tremble slightly.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #Making a run for it while occasionally looking back

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: You rush headlong towards the exit without looking back, behind you the muffled sounds of twisting steel and crumbling concrete. Sporadic gunshots vanish like stones thrown into a deep pool. The noise of the monster crushing equipment intertwines with the frantic cries of livestock, chasing your fleeing footsteps.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: ) Anyone could see that)

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #While running, swiftly writes a letter explaining the general situation, puts on a mask, hands it to a newsboy with some payment, asks him to deliver it to the police station, then chooses to board a train and leave this place.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: ) That's how it is()

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #Seeing the bad ending, helplessly quickly packs up belongings and runs, runs, runs

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: You have indeed reached the limits of your abilities, struggling until the last moment in the vortex of madness and destruction. Yet individual will before the eternal silence of the cosmos is but like a grain of sand dropped into an abyss, not even stirring an echo. The train slowly pulls out of the station, you collapse into the seats like puppets with cut strings, your very marrow soaked in cold futility.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Leans somewhat silently against the train window, watching the scenery outside.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: No one wipes the bloody handprints from the window, no one asks about the direction of the next stop. You are both deserters who abandoned the battlefield, yet also guardians who held out until the end in despair. Moonlight filters through the blinds onto dried bloodstains. In the crevice of reality, everyone has chosen to sink into temporary oblivion.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Can only cast a final glance at the tragedy within, as an outsider looking in.
